storyforge.ai.interpreter.interpret_freeform -> assertion if ever reached (freeform is class AI and is not recorded)
description: Client boot reads on a fresh seed campaign: state, revision, creation catalog, (empty) campaign list, enemy listing per room.

animated_armor_01.description: A suit of plate that still walks its eternal post, attacking all who enter.
animated_armor_01.name: Animated Armor

bandit_01.description: A leather-clad cutpurse with a scimitar and hungry eyes.
bandit_01.name: Bandit

cinderplate_juggernaut.description: A hostile Cinderplate Juggernaut. Wields Forge-Hammer. Armored plating over a molten core. They run hot, cool slow, and leave scorch marks on everything they touch.
cinderplate_juggernaut.name: Cinderplate Juggernaut

forgespawn_soldier.description: A hostile Forgespawn Soldier. Wields Molten Fist. Liquid-metal organisms that cool into whatever shape the battlefield demands. Born in furnaces, comfortable in fire.
forgespawn_soldier.name: Forgespawn Soldier

ghoul_01.description: A hunched, rotting thing. Its claws can paralyze the living.
ghoul_01.name: Ghoul

grimcrow_oracle.description: A hostile Grimcrow Oracle. Wields Fate-Talon. Obsidian-feathered oracles who steal living magic and bind it to bone.
grimcrow_oracle.name: Grimcrow Oracle

ironfast_sentry.description: A hostile Ironfast Sentry. Wields Stone-Crusher Maul. Dwarves whose bones calcified past stone; they are slower, denser, and nearly impossible to put down.
ironfast_sentry.name: Ironfast Sentry

shadow_01.description: A living shadow that drains strength with every touch.
shadow_01.name: Shadow

skeleton_01.description: Reanimated by ancient ruin magic. Its empty sockets glow faint blue.
skeleton_01.name: Skeleton

splitblood_enforcer.description: A hostile Splitblood Enforcer. Wields Half-Blood Axe. Half-orcs whose two halves stopped agreeing during the silence; they are in a constant negotiation with themselves.
splitblood_enforcer.name: Splitblood Enforcer

thornweft_warden.description: A hostile Thornweft Warden. Wields Briar Spear. Wood elves who merged with the forests during the silence; bark grows where skin used to be.
thornweft_warden.name: Thornweft Warden

thug_01.description: A brute with a mace and a neck full of old scars.
thug_01.name: Thug

veilborn_cutpurse.description: A hostile Veilborn Cutpurse. Wields Shadow-Blade. Dark elves who were already living in the dark when the Paradox hit; they adapted faster than anyone and trust no one.
veilborn_cutpurse.name: Veilborn Cutpurse

warpbred_berserker.description: A hostile Warpbred Berserker. Wields Paradox Cleaver. Orcs who leaned into the Paradox and asked it for more; nobody is sure what they traded.
warpbred_berserker.name: Warpbred Berserker

narrative_log.text: The Crooked Tankard's door swings shut behind you. Pipe smoke hangs in the rafters, and a bard by the hearth tunes a battered lute.

bryne.description: D.Anna's son and Kodrik's stepson. Quiet, stocky, and observant. A Warden's Apprentice who notices everything.
bryne.name: Bryne

cinder.description: The tavern's mood-setter. Delivers performances at twice the expected intensity. Emotional hub of the Crooked Tankard.
cinder.name: Cinder Vale

coco.description: Jon and Haylie's Ember Hound. Pure warmth and enthusiasm. Moves at one speed: Enthusiastic. Nose is a heat-seeker for rations.
coco.name: Coco

cyrus.description: A massive Winter Wolf with a smoke-white coat. Kodrik's companion and mate to Keeva. A silent, hearthside deterrent in the Keep.
cyrus.name: Cyrus

danna.description: Head of State of The Feral World. Lover of Kodrik (known and spoken). Commands every room with quiet authority. Commands boons through formal petition.
danna.name: Queen D.Anna

haylie.description: The Real Boss. Runs the inn and the books. Lover and wife to Jon. Maintains the Secret Ledger and Coco's damage reports.
haylie.name: Madame Haylie

keeva.description: The Divine Source of the Realm. She is the light, warmth, and protection felt throughout the world. She IS the realm's foundation.
keeva.name: Keeva

kodrik.description: Guildmaster of the Iron Ledge Company. Lover of Queen D.Anna (known and spoken). Meta-Guide, Mechanic, and Keeper of grounded Lore. His voice lowers as the stakes rise.
kodrik.name: Guildmaster Kodrik

mykael.description: The Supply Hauler and 'Fat Bear'. The strongest entity in the living world for 4 seconds at a time.
mykael.name: Mykael Greenwood

nathis.description: D.Anna's adopted brother. The Front Man. Tall, fast, and always the first through the door.
nathis.name: Nathis

samael.description: Leaning against the back wall. 100% accurate oracle of cosmic and planar lore. Deeply bored.
samael.name: Samael the Ascended

snowie.description: The household's sentinel. A white cat with blue eyes who watches the front gate from the highest point.
snowie.name: Snowie

teddy.description: A young Divine Hound. Granddaughter of Cyrus and Keeva. Living continuation of Keeva's light. Learning the ways of the Heavenly Protector.
teddy.name: Teddy

tyty.description: Nathis's dog. The Wandering Herald. Long ears, long hair, and full volume. Best friend to Teddy.
tyty.name: Tyty

ancient_ruins.description: What was once a grand structure. Broken walls still hold their shape but the roof is long gone. Rubble and moss cover the floor. Something has been worshipping here.
ancient_ruins.name: The Ancient Ruins

back_alley.description: A cramped passage behind the Market Square. Crates are stacked against alcoves. Someone has been here recently — there are still warm ashes from a small fire.
back_alley.name: The Back Alley

cellar_depths.description: Cold stone, standing water, and the smell of old barrels. The damp floor makes movement treacherous. Something scurried in the dark just now.
cellar_depths.name: The Cellar Depths

central_hub.description: The central town square of Iron Ledge, featuring a stone fountain and pathways leading to the various establishments.
central_hub.name: Central Hub

crossroads.description: The beating heart of the Feral World — a broad stone plaza where all roads meet. A central monument of four interlocked pillars marks the Weaver's Paradox. Paths lead north to Ironhold, east to the Market, south to the Nightside, and west to the Wild Reaches.
crossroads.name: The Crossroads

forest_edge.description: The treeline where civilization ends and the untamed world begins. Ancient trunks stand like pillars; an overgrown path leads deeper into the ruins. The Crossroads are just visible to the east.
forest_edge.name: The Wild Reaches

ironhold_keep.description: Ironhold Keep — the Guild's hall of operations. Stone pillars flank a ceremonial carpet leading to the throne seats at the far end.
ironhold_keep.name: Ironhold Keep

keep_barracks.description: The soldiers' quarters inside Ironhold Keep. Rows of bunks, weapons racks, and the smell of boot leather. The Iron Ledge Company's roster is pinned to the center post.
keep_barracks.name: Keep Barracks

keep_courtyard.description: The fortified outer yard of Ironhold Keep. Training racks and supply crates line the walls. Guards patrol in pairs. The keep's iron doors loom to the north; the Crossroads road leads south.
keep_courtyard.name: Keep Courtyard

market_square.description: A lively open square packed with vendor stalls. Bolts of fabric, strange spices, and questionable cures compete for attention. A narrow alley leads east; The Store is south; The Crossroads west.
market_square.name: The Market Square

nightside_square.description: The lower plaza after dark. Lanterns cast warm pools on the cobblestones. The Crooked Tankard glows to the east; the cellar entrance is a heavy door to the west; the Crossroads are north.
nightside_square.name: Nightside Square

store_01.description: The Store — Jon and Haylie's shop. A counter separates the staff from the customer floor. Display shelves line the walls.
store_01.name: The Store

tavern_01.description: The Crooked Tankard — a warm tavern with scattered tables, a performance stage, and a long bar counter.
tavern_01.name: The Crooked Tankard

archive_scholar.flavor: You preserved knowledge of what existed before, cataloguing species and civilizations as they dissolved.
archive_scholar.name: Archive Scholar
archive_scholar.perk_description: Advantage on History and Nature checks related to pre-Paradox civilizations.

feral_wanderer.flavor: You had no home before the Paradox, and nothing to lose when it came. You drifted and survived on instinct alone.
feral_wanderer.name: Feral Wanderer
feral_wanderer.perk_description: You always have advantage on initiative rolls.

paradox_cultist.flavor: You worshipped the coming change, believing the Paradox was divine reckoning. You prepared for it — and it noticed.
paradox_cultist.name: Paradox Cultist
paradox_cultist.perk_description: You have uncanny insight into transformations and can sense when someone is about to change.

remnant_soldier.flavor: You served in the armies of the old world and lived through the Paradox. Your training survived the silence — barely.
remnant_soldier.name: Remnant Soldier
remnant_soldier.perk_description: You cannot be frightened while at full HP.

settlement_warden.flavor: You defended one of the fragile post-Paradox communities that clawed their way back to order. Some even survived.
settlement_warden.name: Settlement Warden
settlement_warden.perk_description: Allies within 10 feet have advantage on saving throws against fear effects.

syndicate_broker.flavor: You ran deals, moved cargo no one was supposed to know about, and kept the underground's lights on through the silence.
syndicate_broker.name: Syndicate Broker
syndicate_broker.perk_description: In any settlement, you can find someone who owes you a favor with a DC 12 Persuasion check.

void_oracle.flavor: The Paradox showed you things — glimpses of what was, what could be, what should never be. You're not sure if it was a gift.
void_oracle.name: Void Oracle
void_oracle.perk_description: Once per day, you may ask the DM a yes/no question about the immediate future.

void_scavenger.flavor: You stripped remnants from dead worlds and dying ships before the Paradox. You know how to find value in decay.
void_scavenger.name: Void Scavenger
void_scavenger.perk_description: You can identify the approximate value and origin of any object with a moment's study.

dialogue_styles.flavor: Precise, measured language. You choose every word deliberately.
dialogue_styles.name: Formal & Eloquent

dialogue_styles.flavor: Plain speech, direct and honest. No pretense.
dialogue_styles.name: Casual & Earthy

dialogue_styles.flavor: Wit is your armor. You deflect with humor.
dialogue_styles.name: Sarcastic & Dry

dialogue_styles.flavor: Silence speaks loudest. You say only what matters.
dialogue_styles.name: Stoic & Minimal

dialogue_styles.flavor: Everything deserves enthusiasm. Volume is your birthright.
dialogue_styles.name: Boisterous & Loud

dialogue_styles.flavor: You speak in metaphor and half-truths. Listeners work for it.
dialogue_styles.name: Cryptic & Mysterious

apex_form.flavor: Desperation unlocks your most dangerous instincts.
apex_form.mechanical_effect: Advantage on STR checks and saving throws when below half maximum HP.
apex_form.name: Apex Form

apex_predator.flavor: Your transformed form inspires primal terror in prey.
apex_predator.name: Apex Predator

echo_memory.flavor: A touch can unlock what a creature knew, felt, or feared.
echo_memory.mechanical_effect: By touching a creature, access its most recent memory (DM discretion).
echo_memory.name: Echo Memory

hive_mind.flavor: You share a wordless psychic link with those you trust.
hive_mind.mechanical_effect: Communicate telepathically with party members within 30 feet.
hive_mind.name: Hive Mind

pack_tactics.mechanical_effect: Advantage on attack rolls when an ally is adjacent to the target.
pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics

phase_shift.flavor: For a single suspended heartbeat, you exist between states.
phase_shift.mechanical_effect: Once per rest, pass through solid objects up to 5 feet.
phase_shift.name: Phase Shift

regenerator.flavor: Your body knits itself back together faster than it can be broken.
regenerator.mechanical_effect: At the start of your turn, if above 0 HP, regain 1 HP.
regenerator.name: Regenerator

void_touched.flavor: The silence between worlds has left its mark on your biology.
void_touched.mechanical_effect: Resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
void_touched.name: Void Touched

ashcrown.flavor: High elves who refused to change and paid for it; regal, brittle, and slowly going translucent.
ashcrown.name: Ashcrown

ashenborn.flavor: Humans who burned through the Paradox and came out the other side charred, fireproof, and furious.
ashenborn.name: Ashenborn

bloodweaver.flavor: Regal horrors who conquer entire bloodlines from the inside out.
bloodweaver.name: Bloodweaver

bonedrifter.flavor: Parasitic beings that rewrite their hosts skeleton-first into living prisons.
bonedrifter.name: Bonedrifter

chaosling.flavor: Twitching fragments of unraveled reality stitched into borrowed flesh.
chaosling.name: Chaosling

cinderkin.flavor: Crystalline fire-sprites forged in the hearts of volcanoes.
cinderkin.name: Cinderkin

cinderplate.flavor: Armored plating over a molten core. They run hot, cool slow, and leave scorch marks on everything they touch.
cinderplate.name: Cinderplate

coreborn.flavor: Deep dwarves who pulled something up from below during the Paradox; it came with them.
coreborn.name: Coreborn

deeptyrant.flavor: Ancient cephalopodic minds who rule kingdoms from the lightless abyss.
deeptyrant.name: Deep-Tyrant

dreamhusk.flavor: Spore-borne entities that project the faces of the beloved dead.
dreamhusk.name: Dreamhusk

duskweft.flavor: Halflings who slipped sideways during the silence and haven't fully come back; they flicker.
duskweft.name: Duskweft

emberpact.flavor: Tieflings whose infernal contracts dissolved in the Paradox; they kept the features and lost the leash.
emberpact.name: Emberpact

embervein.flavor: Molten-blooded leviathans born in the cores of burning worlds.
embervein.name: Embervein

fallenlight.flavor: Aasimars whose divine connection severed; they still glow, but nothing answers when they call.
fallenlight.name: Fallenlight

forgespawn.flavor: Liquid-metal organisms that cool into whatever shape the battlefield demands. Born in furnaces, comfortable in fire.
forgespawn.name: Forgespawn

fractureline.flavor: Half-elves split cleanly down the middle during the Paradox; one half remembers the old world, the other doesn't.
fractureline.name: Fractureline

glitchkin.flavor: Gnomes whose tinkering instinct turned inward; they've been modifying themselves ever since.
glitchkin.name: Glitchkin

grimcrow.flavor: Obsidian-feathered oracles who steal living magic and bind it to bone.
grimcrow.name: Grimcrow

hexgear.flavor: Six-sided modular beings that reconfigure their body layout mid-combat. No consistent face, no consistent silhouette.
hexgear.name: Hexgear

hollowsong.flavor: Elves whose magic inverted; they no longer cast, they absorb, and it's starting to show.
hollowsong.name: Hollowsong

ironfast.flavor: Dwarves whose bones calcified past stone; they are slower, denser, and nearly impossible to put down.
ironfast.name: Ironfast

ironlocust.flavor: Chitinous swarms that strip metal, stone, and bone with equal hunger.
ironlocust.name: Iron-Locust

ironveil.flavor: Gossamer-thin war constructs that fold themselves flat to slip through walls and armor plating. Deceptively fragile looking, catastrophically sharp.
ironveil.name: Ironveil

mindspider.flavor: Translucent arachnids that harvest plans and secrets from sleeping prey.
mindspider.name: Mindspider

nullshade.flavor: Formless hunters that stalk prey from the dark spaces between worlds.
nullshade.name: Nullshade

riftwalker.flavor: Phase-hunters that slip between realms leaving no shadow and no sound.
riftwalker.name: Riftwalker

scaleworn.flavor: Dragonborn whose draconic heritage collapsed inward; the fire is still there, the bloodline is not.
scaleworn.name: Scaleworn

solarlord.flavor: Celestial avians who ride light-paths between suns and speak in stellar fire.
solarlord.name: Solar-Lord

splitblood.flavor: Half-orcs whose two halves stopped agreeing during the silence; they are in a constant negotiation with themselves.
splitblood.name: Splitblood

thornmimic.flavor: Bark-skinned shapeshifters who replace their prey in the oldest forests.
thornmimic.name: Thornmimic

thornweft.flavor: Wood elves who merged with the forests during the silence; bark grows where skin used to be.
thornweft.name: Thornweft

veilborn.flavor: Dark elves who were already living in the dark when the Paradox hit; they adapted faster than anyone and trust no one.
veilborn.name: Veilborn

voidwraith.flavor: Stellar scavengers that feast on dying magic and the bones of dead worlds.
voidwraith.name: Voidwraith

warpbred.flavor: Orcs who leaned into the Paradox and asked it for more; nobody is sure what they traded.
warpbred.name: Warpbred

wirewraith.flavor: Exposed-nerve constructs that transmit pain and data at the same speed. They feel everything, process it, and don't stop moving.
wirewraith.name: Wirewraith

equipment_choices.name: Web Strands
equipment_choices.notes: Restrain a target on a hit.

equipment_choices.name: Paralytic Dust
equipment_choices.notes: DC 13 CON or target is slowed.

equipment_choices.name: Void Battery
equipment_choices.notes: Store stolen energy for a burst attack.

equipment_choices.name: War Banner
equipment_choices.notes: Allies within 10ft gain advantage on morale saves.

equipment_choices.name: Battle Horn
equipment_choices.notes: Demoralize enemies on a successful Intimidation check.

behemoth.flavor: A wall of muscle and chitin. High durability.
behemoth.name: Behemoth

mimic.flavor: Fluid and adaptive body structure. Versatile scout.
mimic.name: Mimic

phantom.flavor: Incorporeal and ethereal. Hard to hit, but fragile.
phantom.name: Phantom

swarm_host.flavor: A living vessel for smaller entities. Balanced power.
swarm_host.name: Swarm-Host

bandit_01.description: A leather-clad cutpurse with a scimitar and hungry eyes.
bandit_01.name: Bandit

thug_01.description: A brute with a mace and a neck full of old scars.
thug_01.name: Thug
